k: The cube that holds the Space Stone
st: Red Skull takes the cube from Tønsberg, Norway, and uses its energy to power HYDRA's weapons.
It burns through Red Skull's bomber and sinks, and after the war Howard Stark pulls it from the ocean floor.
In 1970, Tony and Steve take it from S.H.I.E.L.D. at Camp Lehigh, and Steve later returns it.
Wendy Lawson uses it to power her light-speed engine and hides it in her cloaked lab in orbit.
In 1995, Goose swallows it in Lawson's lab, then coughs it up on Fury's desk.
At a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility, Nick Fury opens a briefcase and asks Erik Selvig to study the cube.
The cube opens a portal for Loki, who steals it and uses it to open the sky over New York to the Chitauri.
After the battle, Thor takes the cube and Loki home to Asgard.
As Asgard falls to Surtur, Loki slips into Odin's vault and eyes the cube.
Loki hands it over to save Thor, and Thanos crushes the cube to take the Space Stone.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Space Stone is gone.
In the Time Heist, a 2012 Loki grabs the cube in the confusion and escapes with it.
The TVA arrests the escaped Loki and confiscates the cube; Infinity Stones are mere paperweights there.

k: The scepter holding the Mind Stone
st: Loki arrives on Earth through the Tesseract's portal with it and bends Clint Barton and Erik Selvig to his will.
Natasha uses it to close the portal over New York, and the scepter passes to S.H.I.E.L.D.
In 2012, Steve takes it from HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D. in a Stark Tower elevator, and later returns it.
In a HYDRA lab, Baron Strucker experiments with it on human test subjects, including twins.
Wanda's memories show the stone inside it waking her powers in a HYDRA lab.
The Avengers seize it in Sokovia, and Tony and Bruce find an AI inside its gem.
Ultron escapes with it, and its gem ends up in the forehead of the new being, Vision.
Thanos reverses time to undo Wanda's attack and rips the Mind Stone from Vision's head.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Mind Stone is gone.

k: An ancient dark force, and an Infinity Stone
The Reality Stone, in liquid form
st: Ages ago, the Dark Elf Malekith tries to unleash it on the Nine Realms, until Bor defeats his forces.
Bor sends it to a hidden world that no one can reach.
Ages later, Jane Foster stumbles onto that world, and it enters her body.
Malekith draws it out of Jane on Svartalfheim and tries to unleash it at the Convergence.
Sif and Volstagg leave it with the Collector on Knowhere, away from the Tesseract.
Thanos takes it from the Collector and uses it to turn Knowhere into an illusion.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Reality Stone is gone.
In 2013, Rocket draws it out of Jane in Asgard, and Steve later goes back to return it.

k: A sphere that holds an Infinity Stone
st: Peter Quill steals it from a vault on Morag, and Gamora and Ronan's men chase him for it.
Ronan's fighters capture it, and Ronan sets its stone in his warhammer.
The Guardians share its power to destroy Ronan, then give it to the Nova Corps on Xandar.
Thanos takes the Power Stone from the Nova Corps, devastating Xandar.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Power Stone is gone.
In 2014, Rhodey and Nebula take the Orb on Morag before Peter can, and Steve later goes back to return it.

k: An ancient relic that can bend time
st: At Kamar-Taj, Strange learns to bend time with it, then traps Dormammu in a loop.
Strange returns it to Kamar-Taj, and Wong reveals it holds an Infinity Stone.
In New York, Strange guards the Time Stone from Ebony Maw, who drags him aboard his ship.
On Titan, Strange gives the stone to Thanos to save Tony's life.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Time Stone is gone.
In 2012, the Ancient One gives Bruce her Time Stone, and Steve later goes back to return it.

k: An Infinity Stone that demands a sacrifice
st: On Vormir, its keeper Red Skull tells Thanos it can only be had by sacrificing someone he loves.
Thanos throws Gamora from the cliff and wakes with the stone in his hand.
Thanos uses the stones to destroy the stones, so the Soul Stone is gone.
In 2014, Natasha gives her life so Clint can take it; Steve later goes back to return it.

k: A golden gauntlet built to hold the Infinity Stones
st: Thanos takes an empty golden gauntlet from a vault and vows to get the stones himself.
Eitri forged it for Thanos, who fills it with all six stones and snaps away half of all life.
Thanos uses it to destroy the stones, wrecking it and his arm, and Thor cuts off his head.

k: A golden gauntlet among Odin's treasures
st: A golden gauntlet sits among the treasures in Odin's vault.
Hela calls it a fake and knocks it over, before Surtur destroys Asgard and the vault.

k: A gauntlet Tony, Bruce and Rocket build for the stones
st: Tony, Bruce and Rocket build it for the stones from the past, and Bruce snaps to bring everyone back.
Heroes carry it across the battlefield, but the 2014 Thanos seizes it and puts it on.
Tony slips the stones into his own armor and snaps the 2014 Thanos away.
Thor fights the Frost Giants of Jotunheim with his hammer.
Odin enchants it so only the worthy can lift it and casts it to Earth after Thor.
Agent Coulson finds a large hammer in a crater in the New Mexico desert.
S.H.I.E.L.D. builds a site around it, and once Thor proves worthy it flies back to him to fight the Destroyer.
In 2013, Thor calls his hammer and takes it to the present, where Steve wields it; Steve later returns it.
At the Avengers' party, no one can lift it; later Vision lifts it easily and hands it to Thor.
In Norway, Hela catches it in one hand and crushes it to pieces.
Its shards in New Asgard reform for Jane Foster, who fights Gorr with it as the Mighty Thor.
After Jane dies, Thor wields it again.

k: A battle axe forged on Nidavellir to kill Thanos
st: Thor, Rocket and Groot help Eitri forge it on Nidavellir, and Thor drives it into Thanos's chest in Wakanda.
Thor cuts off Thanos's head with it, and later fights the 2014 Thanos with axe and hammer.
Gorr steals it in the Shadow Realm and uses it to open the way to Eternity.
Afterward, Thor adopts Gorr's daughter Love, who wields it.
Howard Stark gives Steve a round vibranium shield, and he fights HYDRA with it.
It goes down with Steve and Red Skull's bomber in the Arctic.
In the present day, a team in the Arctic finds an old aircraft with someone frozen inside and the shield.
Steve carries the shield again in the Battle of New York.
Steve leaves the shield behind in Siberia after Tony tells him his father made it.
Tony gives it back to Steve, who fights Thanos with it until Thanos's blade chips it apart.
An old Steve hands a shield to Sam.
Sam gives the shield to the government for a museum display.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
The government hands it to its new Captain America, John Walker.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam and Bucky take it back from Walker, and Sam flies with it as Captain America.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam carries the shield as Captain America against Serpent and the red Hulk.

k: A half-built copy of Captain America's shield
st: A partly built round shield sits on Tony's workbench.
Coulson spots it, and Tony uses it to prop up his homemade particle accelerator.

k: An arrow Yondu steers by whistling
st: Yondu steers the arrow by whistling, cutting down Ronan's soldiers on Xandar.
After the mutiny takes his fin, Yondu gets a prototype fin, kills the mutineers and blows up his ship.
After Yondu dies saving Peter, Kraglin takes up the arrow and the fin.
Kraglin fights with the arrow as the Guardians defend Knowhere.
Clint Barton watches over S.H.I.E.L.D.'s site at the hammer with his bow as Thor breaks in.
Clint fights for Loki, then with the Avengers in the Battle of New York.
Clint fights Ultron's drones in Sokovia with his bow.
Clint comes out of retirement with his bow to fight beside Steve at Leipzig airport.
In New York at Christmas, Clint fights the Tracksuit Mafia with his bow beside Kate Bishop.

k: Arrows that explode, hack or grow
st: Clint fires an arrow that knocks out a Helicarrier engine, then explosive arrows at the Chitauri.
Clint and Kate escape the Tracksuit Mafia using his trick arrows.
LARPers retrieve Clint's trick arrows for Kate, who uses them to take down Kingpin.

k: The katana Clint hunts criminals with
Clint's katana from his years as Ronin
st: Hooded, Clint hunts criminals in Tokyo with a sword until Natasha finds him.
Recovered from the Compound's ruins, it turns up at a black market auction, and Jack Duquesne takes it.
With Laura's help, Clint secretly takes his sword back.
Natasha fights Ultron and his drones with electrified batons.
Natasha fights Taskmaster and the Widows with her batons.
Natasha slaps an electric disc onto the Winter Soldier's metal arm in a street fight.
Odin carries his spear to Jotunheim to pull Thor out of his fight with the Frost Giants.
With Odin in the Odinsleep, Loki takes the throne and the spear, and kills Laufey with it.
Dangling from the broken Bifrost, Loki lets go of it and falls, and it returns to Odin.

k: The giant warhammer of Ronan the Accuser
st: Ronan the Accuser carries his warhammer as his Kree bombers threaten Earth, then retreats.
Ronan sets the Orb's stone in it, but Drax and Rocket shatter it on Xandar.
Rocket's big gun helps shatter Ronan's warhammer on Xandar.
Years ago, Yondu gives young Peter a pair of blasters as a Christmas present.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Peter shoots his way past Korath's men on Morag with his blasters.

k: A Chitauri gun left behind in New York
st: A broke couple, Bennie and Claire, find the Chitauri gun and rob banks with it.
Agent Sitwell takes the gun and recruits them to S.H.I.E.L.D.
Tony demonstrates the Jericho in Afghanistan, and the Ten Rings later demand he build one for them.

k: Electric whips powered by an arc reactor
st: Ivan Vanko attacks Tony at Monaco with whips powered by his own arc reactor, until he is beaten and arrested.
Vanko returns in new armor with new whips, then blows himself up with his drones.
The 2014 Thanos uses it to hack apart Captain America's shield in the Battle of Earth.
Tony's snap turns the 2014 Thanos and his army to dust.

k: A Chitauri-tech gauntlet that fires shock blasts
st: Jackson Brice fights Spider-Man with it as the Shocker.
After Toomes accidentally kills Brice, Herman Schultz takes the gauntlet as the new Shocker.
Peter beats Schultz with Ned's help, and the Shocker is left for the police.
In 1896, Prince Tafari takes the vibranium axe from the battlefield at Adwa to bring it home.
Warned by a Black Panther from the future, he puts it back, and years later it sits in a London museum.
Killmonger and Klaue steal it from the museum, and Klaue tries to sell it to the CIA in Busan.
The Busan sale ends in a firefight, and Killmonger later kills Klaue.

k: A prosthetic arm hiding a sonic cannon
st: Klaue's prosthetic arm hides a vibranium sonic cannon, which he fires in Busan.
Killmonger breaks Klaue out of CIA custody, then kills him and brings his body to Wakanda.
The Grandmaster melts his cousin Carlo with it.

k: A mystic relic of the Masters
st: Wong holds it as Kaecilius's zealots cut him down in Hong Kong, before Strange turns back time.

k: Tony Stark's line of Iron Man suits
st: Back home, Tony builds a sleek red and gold suit, beats Obadiah Stane, and admits he is Iron Man.
Tony's suitcase suit saves him at Monaco, and he and Rhodey defeat Vanko's drones.
Tony flies a nuke through the wormhole and falls back to Earth when his suit loses power.
Tony's remote suits help save the President, then J.A.R.V.I.S. destroys them all as a gift to Pepper.
Back in armor, Tony leads the Avengers against Ultron's army in Sokovia.
In Siberia, Steve disables Tony's armor after their fight over Bucky.
Tony's nanotech suit flows out of his chest, but on Titan Thanos stabs him.
Tony slips the stones into his armor and snaps Thanos away, at the cost of his life.

k: Tony's first armor, built in a cave
st: In a Ten Rings cave, Tony and Yinsen secretly build an armored suit, and Tony escapes in it.
It crashes in the desert in pieces, and the Ten Rings gather them up.
Raza brings the pieces to Obadiah Stane, who has his men killed and copies the design.
Stane builds a massive suit from the Mark I wreckage and fights Tony in it.
Pepper overloads the big arc reactor, and the blast destroys the suit and kills Stane.
Tony tests a silver prototype suit in his workshop, and Rhodey eyes it.
Rhodey takes the prototype, and Hammer arms it as War Machine; Rhodey fights Vanko beside Tony.
Repainted as the Iron Patriot, it is stolen, and Savin wears it to get at the President.
Rhodey takes it back on the oil rig and frees the President, who was strung up in it.
Rhodey flies as War Machine to help evacuate Sokovia.
Vision accidentally shoots Rhodey down over the airport, leaving him partly paralyzed.
Rhodey flies as War Machine against Thanos's army in Wakanda.
Rhodey wears it to steal the Power Stone on Morag in 2014, and in the Battle of Earth.

k: Tony's heavy armor built to stop the Hulk
st: Tony calls in his anti-Hulk armor to stop the Hulk's rampage in Johannesburg.
Unable to become the Hulk, Bruce fights Thanos's army in the Hulkbuster in Wakanda.

k: A suit Tony built for Pepper
st: Pepper flies into the Battle of Earth in a suit of her own.
Steve wears a stage costume to sell war bonds, then a combat uniform Howard Stark makes him.
Steve fights in a new uniform that Coulson helped design.
Steve wears a stealth suit for S.H.I.E.L.D., then takes his old WWII uniform from the Smithsonian.
On the run, Steve wears a dark suit with the star torn off.
Steve wears his uniform into the Battle of Earth.
Steve and Natasha help Sam take his Falcon wingpack from Fort Meade.
The Winter Soldier destroys it on a Helicarrier.
With new wings, Sam fights a tiny intruder at the Avengers' headquarters.
Sam flies for Steve's side at Leipzig airport, and is locked in the Raft.
Sam flies against Thanos's army in Wakanda.
Walker wrecks the wingsuit in a fight, and Sam leaves it with Joaquin Torres.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Joaquin Torres flies with Sam's old wings as the new Falcon.
The Winter Soldier's metal arm, marked with a red star, catches Cap's shield.
In Siberia, Tony blasts the arm off.
Wakanda gives Bucky a new vibranium arm before Thanos's army attacks.
In a fight over Zemo, Ayo shows she can pop the Wakandan arm right off.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now a congressman, Bucky still fights with the vibranium arm.
T'Challa hunts Bucky as the Black Panther in a vibranium suit.
Shuri gives T'Challa a nanotech suit that stores energy and lives in his necklace.
T'Challa leads Wakanda's army against Thanos's forces.
T'Challa returns in his suit to fight in the Battle of Earth.
After T'Challa dies of an illness, Shuri takes the herb and becomes the Black Panther in a new suit.
Killmonger fights T'Challa in a gold nanotech suit.
T'Challa shorts it out in the vibranium mine and stabs Killmonger, who dies.

k: The suit Tony made for Peter
st: Tony brings Peter a new high tech suit to fight Cap's team at Leipzig airport.
Peter and Ned unlock the suit's hidden features, until Tony takes it away after the ferry disaster.
After Peter stops the Vulture, Tony gives the suit back to him.
On Happy's jet, Peter designs a new red and black suit for the fight in London.
After Strange's spell makes everyone forget him, Peter sews a new suit of his own.
Tony finds Peter's homemade costume in his room before giving him a new suit.
With his Stark suit taken away, Peter wears the homemade one to stop the Vulture.

k: A new suit Tony offers Peter
st: Tony shows Peter a new suit and a place with the Avengers, but Peter turns it down.
The suit flies to Peter as he clings to Maw's ship, and he fights Thanos in it on Titan.
Peter swings into the Battle of Earth in the Iron Spider.
Otto Octavius rips nanotech from the Iron Spider, which bonds with his tentacles.
Adrian Toomes builds a winged flying suit from Chitauri salvage and steals with it for years.
The damaged suit explodes on Coney Island beach, and Peter saves Toomes's life.
Hank Pym, the first Ant-Man, keeps his old suit locked in a safe in his house.
Scott steals it from the safe, and Hank trains him as the new Ant-Man.
Scott grows to giant size in it at Leipzig airport.
Scott fights Ghost and Sonny Burch beside the Wasp in it.
Freed from the Quantum Realm, Scott uses the suit for the Time Heist.
Scott wears the suit in the Quantum Realm against Kang.

k: A shrinking suit with wings and blasters
st: Janet van Dyne vanished in the first Wasp suit in 1987; Hank shows Hope a new prototype.
Hope fights Sonny Burch's men and Ghost as the Wasp.
Hope flies as the Wasp in the Battle of Earth.
Hope fights Kang's forces as the Wasp in the Quantum Realm.
Darren Cross builds his own shrinking suit to sell, then wears it to fight Scott.
Scott goes subatomic to sabotage it, and it shrinks out of control.

k: A suit that holds Ava Starr together
st: Ava Starr, the Ghost, uses her suit to phase through walls and steal Hank's lab.
Ava phases through walls in her suit as one of the Thunderbolts.

k: Suits for traveling through the Quantum Realm
st: The Avengers jump into the past in white and red quantum suits to steal the stones.

k: The hooded suit Clint hunts criminals in
Clint's hooded suit from his years as Ronin
st: After his family is dusted, Clint hunts criminals as a hooded killer.
Found in the Compound's ruins, it turns up at a black market auction, and Kate Bishop fights in it.
Left behind when the Tracksuits raid Kate's apartment, it ends up with Grills, a firefighter who wears it to a LARP.
Clint wins it back at the LARP, and later wears it one last time to face Maya.
Back home with his family on Christmas Day, Clint burns it.

k: The Soviet super soldier's old suit
st: Alexei squeezes back into his old Red Guardian suit for the raid on the Red Room.
Alexei suits up as the Red Guardian again with the Thunderbolts.

k: The armored suit of the Red Room's Taskmaster
st: Taskmaster hunts Natasha, until Natasha frees Antonia Dreykov from her father's control.
Antonia, as Taskmaster, is killed by Ghost in an O.X.E. vault.

k: Carol's red, blue and gold suit
st: Carol wears a green Starforce uniform, then turns it red, blue and gold, colors Monica picks.
Carol flies into the Battle of Earth and destroys Thanos's warship.
Carol fights Dar-Benn beside Monica and Kamala.
Peter wears his mask to steal the Orb on Morag.
In space, he gives it to Gamora so she can survive, until Yondu's ship picks them up.
Peter masks up to fight Thanos on Titan.
Thanos sits on his throne in armor as Ronan reports to him.
In armor, Thanos takes up an empty gauntlet.
Years later, his armor hangs like a scarecrow in his garden when Thor kills him.
The 2014 Thanos wears his armor to the Battle of Earth, until Tony's snap turns him to dust.

k: An enchanted metal guardian of Odin's vault
st: The Destroyer guards Odin's vault and burns the Frost Giants who break in.
Ruling Asgard, Loki sends it to Earth to kill Thor.
Thor, worthy again, destroys it in New Mexico.

k: A green vest with lots of pockets
st: Yelena loves her vest for its many pockets.
Yelena gives it to Natasha when they part.
Natasha wears the vest against Thanos's army in Wakanda.

k: The power source that keeps Tony alive
st: Tony builds one in a cave to protect his heart; when Stane steals the new one, the first, framed by Pepper, saves him.
Its palladium core poisons Tony, until he builds a new element to replace it.
After surgery removes the shrapnel, Tony throws his chest reactor into the sea.
At Tony's funeral, Pepper floats his first framed reactor out on the lake.
Tony's Iron Legion drones help the Avengers raid Strucker's base in Sokovia.
Ultron takes them over to attack the Avengers' party, and the team destroys them.

k: The robot bodies and drones of Ultron
st: Ultron upgrades a wrecked drone into his first body, then builds an army of drones in Sokovia.
Wanda tears out his main body's core, and Vision destroys the last drone.

k: A machine that grows synthetic tissue
st: Dr. Helen Cho's machine knits Clint's wound shut at Avengers Tower.
In Seoul, Ultron enslaves Cho and has her grow a vibranium body in it.
The Avengers seize it, and Vision rises from it at Avengers Tower.

k: Armored drones built by Ivan Vanko
st: Vanko builds drones for Justin Hammer, who unveils them at the Stark Expo.
Vanko hijacks them to attack Tony, until Tony and Rhodey beat them and they blow up.

k: A program that picks HYDRA's future enemies
st: Zola's algorithm marks millions as threats to HYDRA, targets for Project Insight.
It falls with the Insight Helicarriers when Steve's team turns their guns on each other.

k: A drive full of the Lemurian Star's data
st: Natasha copies the Lemurian Star's data onto a drive, which Fury can't decrypt.
Shot, Fury hands it to Steve, who hides it in a vending machine, and it leads him to Zola's bunker.

k: A pager modified to reach Carol Danvers
st: Before leaving Earth, Carol gives Fury a modified pager to call her in an emergency.
Fury sends a signal on it just before he turns to dust.
At the Avengers Compound, the survivors watch the pager until Carol appears.
Wendy Lawson builds an engine that runs on the Tesseract and tests it with pilot Carol Danvers.
In 1989, Yon-Rogg kills Lawson, and Carol destroys the engine to keep it from the Kree, absorbing its energy.

k: A Kree device that limits Carol's power
st: The Kree fit Carol with an implant that holds back her power.
Carol tears it out to reach her full strength.

k: Wakandan beads that hold all kinds of tech
st: Shuri's beads let her drive a car in Busan from Wakanda, and one keeps Everett Ross alive.
Peter's homemade web-shooters impress Tony, who builds him new ones.
Peter fights the Vulture's crew with webs of many kinds.

k: Alien weapons and machines left in New York
st: The Chitauri invade New York with alien guns, flying chariots and giant Leviathans.
They drop dead when their mothership blows up, leaving the wreckage across the city.
Adrian Toomes's crew keep salvage from the battle and turn it into weapons they sell for years.
Peter stops the Vulture, and Toomes goes to prison.

k: Devices that bend space at the Convergence
st: Jane's group plant the spikes in Greenwich and send Malekith back to Svartalfheim.

k: A machine that opens a way to the Quantum Realm
st: Hank and Hope build a tunnel to the Quantum Realm, and Hank brings Janet home.
After sending Scott in, Hank, Hope and Janet turn to dust, leaving him stranded.
A rat sets off the tunnel in Luis's van and frees Scott; the Avengers build a bigger one for the Time Heist.
The 2014 Nebula uses it to bring Thanos's warship to the present, and it bombs the Compound.

k: A wrist device to steer through time
st: Tony solves time travel, and each Avenger wears a wrist GPS to jump through the Quantum Realm.

k: The FBI's house arrest monitor on Scott
st: Under house arrest, Scott wears the monitor, and a giant ant wears it as a decoy while he's out.
Jimmy Woo frees Scott from house arrest.

k: Sakaaran disks that shock whoever wears them
st: Scrapper 142 drops Thor with a disk and sells him to the Grandmaster, who controls him with it.
Thor slaps one on Loki to stop his betrayal and leaves him twitching on the floor.
At MIT, Tony uses BARF to relive his last day with his parents.
Quentin Beck, who built it, turns its holograms into fake Elemental attacks.
Peter wrecks Beck's drones, and Beck is shot by one of them and dies.
Sam scouts a Lagos market with his drone, Redwing.
Redwing flies with Sam against Batroc's hijackers over Tunisia.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
The Sovereign hire the Guardians to guard their precious batteries from a space monster.
Rocket steals some of them as the Guardians leave.
Rocket turns them into the bomb Groot plants on Ego's brain.
Howard Stark doses Steve with vita-rays in it to finish Erskine's treatment.

k: A living cloak that chooses its wearer
st: The Cloak picks Strange in the New York Sanctum and helps him hold off Kaecilius.
The Cloak slips free on Ebony Maw's ship and helps rescue Strange.
Strange wears it into the Battle of Earth.
Strange wears it against Wanda across the multiverse.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: Rings sorcerers use to open portals
st: The Ancient One strands Strange on Everest until he learns to open a portal with a sling ring.
Strange and the sorcerers open portals for Earth's armies in the Battle of Earth.
Wong opens a portal to leave an underground fight club with Abomination.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Ned finds he can open portals with Strange's sling ring.
Cassandra Nova uses a sling ring to open a portal out of the Void.

k: An ancient book in Kamar-Taj's library
st: Kaecilius steals pages from it; Strange reads the rest and learns to bend time with the Eye.

k: The source of the frost giants' power
st: In 965 AD, Laufey's Frost Giants use it to freeze Earth.
Odin seizes it for his vault; when Loki touches it there, his skin turns blue.
It sits in Odin's vault as Hela walks by, before Surtur destroys Asgard.
Surtur wears his crown in Muspelheim as he plans to destroy Asgard.
Thor beats him and takes the crown to Asgard, believing he has stopped Ragnarok.
Loki puts it in the Eternal Flame, and Surtur is reborn to destroy Asgard.

k: A formula that makes super soldiers
st: Erskine's early formula scars Schmidt, and his finished serum turns Steve into a super soldier.
A HYDRA spy kills Erskine and flees with the last vial, which breaks in the chase, and the formula is lost.
Isaiah Bradley tells how the government tested a serum on him and other Black soldiers.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
In 1991, the Winter Soldier takes a case of serum from Howard Stark's car for HYDRA's super soldiers.
General Ross has Emil Blonsky injected with a serum from the old super soldier program.
Nagel remakes the serum for the Power Broker, but Karli steals all 20 doses for the Flag Smashers.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Zemo destroys most of the doses, and John Walker takes the last one himself.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Hank Pym hides his formula from S.H.I.E.L.D.; years later, Scott shrinks with it in Hank's suit.
Hank and Hope shrink a whole lab to the size of a suitcase.
With only enough for one round trip each, Steve takes more from Hank's lab at Camp Lehigh in 1970.
Clint fires a Pym arrow at Kate's arrow, which grows giant and crushes a truck.
In the Quantum Realm, Scott and Hope throw Kang into his power core along with Pym Particles.

k: A regenerative treatment that burns hot
st: In 1999, scientist Maya Hansen shows Tony Extremis, her regenerative treatment.
Killian's A.I.M. turns it into soldiers who burn and explode.
Killian gives Pepper Extremis, and she uses its power to kill him.
Tony stabilizes Pepper and rids her of it.
G'iah secretly gives herself Extremis with Gravik's machine, and it lets her survive his gunshot.
In 1992, Ulysses Klaue steals vibranium from Wakanda with help from N'Jobu.
Ultron takes Klaue's stockpile, cuts off his arm, and builds the body that becomes Vision from it.

k: A Wakandan plant that grants a Black Panther's power
st: T'Challa takes the herb's power to become king and the Black Panther.
Killmonger takes the herb and orders the garden burned, but Nakia escapes with one.
Nakia's herb heals T'Challa among the Jabari.
Shuri rebuilds the herb from a Talokan plant, takes it, and plants more.

k: A gas that frees Widows from mind control
st: Freed by the gas, Yelena sends vials of it to Natasha, who drives around with them unknowingly.
Yelena frees Widows with it at the Red Room, and Natasha gives her the last vial to free the rest.

k: A scent that stops any Widow from hurting Dreykov
st: Dreykov's pheromone lock stops any Widow from striking him.
Natasha breaks her own nose to beat it, and Dreykov dies when Yelena blows up his base.
Peggy Carter recovers the Zodiac by herself, against SSR procedure.

k: Blood carrying the Hulk's gamma power
st: Samuel Sterns turns Bruce's samples into a supply; Blonsky takes a dose, and some gets in Sterns's cut.
In a car crash, Bruce's blood gets into his cousin Jennifer Walters, and she becomes a Hulk too.
Samuel Sterns gained a great intellect from Bruce's blood, and turns it against Ross.

k: A new element Howard Stark designed
st: Tony finds the element's structure hidden in his father's Expo model, and builds it to save his life.
Loki's agents attack S.H.I.E.L.D.'s flying base, and Tony and Steve restart a damaged engine.
Fury arrives in an old Helicarrier to evacuate the people of Sokovia.

k: Three Helicarriers linked to spy satellites
st: HYDRA plans to kill millions with them, until Steve's team swaps their chips and they destroy each other.
Natasha flies a S.H.I.E.L.D. Quinjet, carrying Steve to fight Loki in Stuttgart.
